what: Video and photo rows sit stacked small at .56 scale, overlapping each other (−21% below). Only the one whose top edge passes the 60% line of the screen swells to full size over 1.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). When the next one crosses the line, the previous one shrinks back around its top. The title column beside them rolls up to the current item over 1.25s expo.inOut. Below 992px nothing shrinks and the rows simply line up

options.line: Line that lights up (screen height %), default 60%
options.--fx-small·--fx-overlap·--fx-overlap-act: Scale when small, overlap, overlap when on (CSS variables), defaults .56 · −21% · −22%
options.[data-fx-part=titles]: (optional) titles in turn inside a cell cropped to one line height — used stuck at screen center with sticky

note: The consumer clips the title cell to a one-line height (overflow: clip). For a year line, the original swaps in a digit-strip counter (site copy about.js)

from.where: index.js·about.js work rows·showreel rows (original project-feed: 8 cells + 6.2em inner, .56x, 60% line, title 1.25s)
